bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
candidates='28b1ab9ee02215be5919f5a2b004509714e2681c 25e003fb431abce5a777e964f04c1bd8567e9a70 93cf8687677b418e4b2a04820ed3906851f03d1e 4274b9717b28fc7fba9b37233dd1c6834f6982ab c22ffc587781874ef463c2d912774376fb4e55a8 807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf'
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
mask=0
bit=1
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs; do
 live="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 62
 found=NO
 for commit in $candidates; do
  if git -C "$src" cat-file -e "$commit:$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    value="$(git -C "$src" show "$commit:$p" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
    if test "$value" = "$live"; then found=YES; echo "VIDEO_BASE_MATCH_$bit=$commit"; break; fi
  fi
 done
 if test "$found" = NO; then echo "VIDEO_BASE_MATCH_$bit=UNKNOWN";mask=$((mask+bit));fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
if test "$mask" -gt 0;then echo "VIDEO_LIVE_UNKNOWN_MASK=$mask";exit $((80+mask));fi
echo VIDEO_LIVE_ALL_FILES_MATCH_VERIFIED_SOURCE=PASS
